summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a Theatre Comique advertisement billing Tom Allen and Jem Mace as "the Two Champions of the World" in a grand boxing match on Tuesday and Wednesday evenings.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Republican, Tuesday Morning, October 24, 1876', page 5; filed as Missouri Republican per rubric (pre-1888), not the St. Louis Republic

facts.fact: The Theatre Comique advertised Allen and Jem Mace, 'the Two Champions of the World', in a grand boxing match on October 24 and 25, 1876
places: Theatre Comique, Pine Street between Third and Fourth, St. Louis
